proposedOperatorData.name: MountainXperience
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Mountain specialists guiding Snowdon, Crib Goch and the peaks of Eryri
proposedOperatorData.description:
MountainXperience is a mountain guiding and outdoor-skills business based in Llanberis, in the heart of Snowdonia (Eryri) National Park, North Wales. Led by owner-instructor Simon, the company offers guided ascents of Snowdon, Tryfan and Moel Siabod, scrambling routes including Crib Goch and the full Snowdon Horseshoe, sunrise hikes, winter climbing and wild camping trips.

Alongside guided walks, the business runs formal outdoor training: NNAS Navigation Awards (Bronze, Silver and Gold), Hill Skills, Mountain Skills, Scrambling Skills, Winter Skills and Outdoor First Aid certification. It also arranges private guiding, custom itineraries and corporate or charity team-building days.

MountainXperience is ranked #1 of 32 outdoor-activity operators in Llanberis on TripAdvisor, has won TripAdvisor's Travellers' Choice Award five years running (2022-2026), and holds a Gold Level Snowdonia Ambassador Award.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: 5.0-rated, multi-award-winning local Llanberis guides (TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice 2022-2026) offering both guided ascents and accredited NNAS navigation and mountain-skills training.
